# Test fixtures

Tiny files (< 50 KB each) used by the derivative worker tests (`src/derivatives/*.spec.ts`).

| File | Content | Generated by |
|---|---|---|
| `rotated.jpg` | 64x32 JPEG, left half red / right half blue, EXIF orientation 6 | `generate.mjs` (sharp) |
| `sample.png` | 80x60 green PNG | `generate.mjs` (sharp) |
| `script.svg` | SVG with `<script>`, `onload`, a `file://` image and a `javascript:` link | `generate.mjs` |
| `sample.pdf` | one-page PDF (blue rectangle), hand-written with a valid xref | `generate.mjs` |
| `sample.txt`, `sample.md`, `sample.ts` | text | `generate.mjs` |
| `sample.mp4` | 2 s H.264 test pattern, 96x64 | ffmpeg (below) |
| `sample.mp3` | 1 s 440 Hz sine | ffmpeg (below) |
| `sample.heic` | `sample.png` encoded as HEIC | heif-enc in a container (below) |

Commands (run in `apps/server/test/fixtures`; `generate.mjs` first, since `sample.heic` is made from `sample.png`):

```sh
node generate.mjs

ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i "testsrc=duration=2:size=96x64:rate=10" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -y sample.mp4
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 32k -y sample.mp3

# heif-enc is not available on the dev Mac; a disposable Debian container is used instead:
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/fx -w /fx debian:bookworm-slim sh -c \
  'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends libheif-examples && heif-enc -q 50 -o sample.heic sample.png'
```

The decompression-bomb PNG is not stored; the test generates it with sharp at run time.
